note: Erdae text of the peace council window (vanilla file peace_l_english.yml). Keys are the engine's and keep every placeholder; the builder writes them to localisation/replace/zin_leagues_l_english.yml. The currency of the council is called Spoils, the rounds Rounds, and the council is the Peace Council (glossary).

peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_ANNEX_COUNTRY: $TAKER|Y$ absorbs $GIVER|Y$ and gains all its lands.
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_GIVE_PEACE_SCORE: $GIVER|Y$ yields all its remaining Spoils to $TAKER|Y$
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_TAKE_NAVY: @$GIVERTAG$$GIVER|Y$ gives $CAPITAL_SHIP|Y$ and $AMOUNT|%Y0$ of its escort ships to @$TAKERTAG$$TAKER|Y$
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_TAKE_NAVY_ONLY_SCREEN: @$GIVERTAG$$GIVER|Y$ gives all its escort ships to @$TAKERTAG$$TAKER|Y$
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_DEMILITARIZED_ZONE: and this land becomes an Unarmed March
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_WAR_REPARATION: and this land pays a Blood-Price
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_RESOURCE_RIGHTS: and this land yields Rights to its Harvest
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_DISMANTLE_INDUSTRY: and the smithies of this land are broken
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_TAKE_STATES_DEMAND_DESC: Bring land under your own banner.
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_GIVE_STATES_DEMAND_DESC: Bring land under another realm's banner.
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_LIBERATE_DESC: Restore an old realm held in bondage by one of the defeated. Restored realms are shown in the Beneficiaries tab.
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_PUPPET_COUNTRY_DESC: Make one of the defeated realms a vassal. Vassal realms are shown in the Beneficiaries tab.
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_FORCE_GOVERNMENT_DESC: Change the alignment of one of the defeated realms. The realm is forced to take up your alignment.
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_TAKE_NAVY_DESC: Claim §HGreat Warships§! for your own fleet. When the council ends, the §HEscort Ships§! are divided among those who claimed great warships, in the measure of the price of the great warships taken from each defeated realm.
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_DEMILITARIZED_ZONE_DESC: Forbid new forts, and forbid hosts to pass through a fitting land, for $NUM_DAYS|H$ days.
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_WAR_REPARATION_DESC: Seize the §HGuild Workshops§! of a fitting land for $NUM_DAYS|H$ days.
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_RESOURCE_RIGHTS_DESC: Seize the §HYield§! of a fitting land for $NUM_DAYS|H$ days.
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_DISMANTLE_INDUSTRY_DESC: Destroy the §HArmouries§! of a fitting land.
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_ONLY_MAIN_COUNTRY_LEADER_CAN_ACT: §HYou are not the chief ruler, and cannot make terms in the council.§!
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_END_TURN_DESC:
You have chosen $NUM$ terms.

§HSend§! them to move the council to its next round.
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_END_TURN_EXPECTED_CONTEST_DESC: Some of the demands you have chosen will become a £peace_conf_icons|3 §Rcontested demand§!, because another realm has already asked for the same.
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_DONE_POPUP_DESCRIPTION:
Will you leave the Peace Council?

Terms you have already won will stand, but may be §Rcontested§! if others are still making demands. If that happens you will be called back to the council.
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_DONE_HAS_TAKEN_ACTION: §RYou have made demands this round. Withdraw them if you want to leave the council.§!
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_DONE_DESC:
Press this to leave the Peace Council. Terms you have already won will stand, but may be §Rcontested§! if others are still making demands. If that happens you will be called back to the council.

Leave when you are content with your gains.
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_PASS_DESC: If you pass this round, others may spend their Spoils on demands.
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_PASS_EMPTY: §RNothing is left to take this round§!
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_CONFERENCE_PASS: End your round in the council
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_CONFERENCE_PASS_DESC:
You still hold §Y$VALUE$§! Spoils that you can spend.
You may not have another chance to spend them.
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_CONFERENCE_PASS_ACTIONS_DESC: §RYou cannot pass while you hold chosen terms that are not yet sent§!
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_CONFERENCE_SEND_DESC: Send the chosen terms as demands, for a price of §Y$VALUE$§!
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_CONFERENCE_COST_TOO_HIGH: §RYou do not hold enough Spoils for the chosen demands§!
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_CONFERENCE_COST_TOO_HIGH_NEXT_PART: §RYou cannot make these demands this round, for they would leave your Spoils far below the next in turn§!
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_CONFERENCE_FORCE_GOVERNMENT: The $IDEOLOGY|Y$ party $PARTY|Y$ has been set upon the throne of @$TAG$$COUNTRY|Y$.
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_CONFERENCE_WHITE_PEACE:
@$ACTOR_TAG$$ACTOR_COUNTRY|Y$ and $RECIPIENT_COUNTRY|Y$@$RECIPIENT_TAG$
have sworn a §Ypeace without spoils§!.
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_WAITING_PLAYERS_MAKE_DEMANDS: Waiting for £players_icon£ the players to make Demands
peace_l_english.yml.CONFERENCE_LOSER_IS_UNTOUCHED: $NAME|Y$ is untouched by any of the victors, so no demands can be made against them
peace_l_english.yml.CAPITULATE_HOME_AREA_DESC:
$LOSER|Y$ has fallen.
The $LOSER_ADJ$ court has gone into exile, and the main hosts have yielded to $WINNER|Y$, who now hold their home lands.
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_PARTICIPANT_TAKE_ALL_STATES: Click to take all lands, right-click to open a list of all lands
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_PARTICIPANT_TAKE_ALL_STATES_EXPAND: Click to open a list of all lands
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_CONFERENCE_CALCULATING: Reckoning the terms of the council...
peace_l_english.yml.PEACECONFERENCE_COMPLETE:
The Peace Council is over
Reckoning the terms...
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_BIDDINGS_POPUP_DESCRIPTION:
Your Demand for $BIDNAME|Y$ has been £peace_conf_icons|3 §Rcontested§!, because another realm has a Demand on the same land. Make another Demand on the contested land to keep it, or forfeit to stop following it.

Contested Demands are not counted among the Demands you have sent. If you do not renew this Demand it will not stand with your won terms.
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_BIDDINGS_POPUP_REFUNDED_SCORE_TOOL:
§HReturned Spoils§! £victory_points  $AMOUNT_REFUNDED$

All of your Spoils were §Hreturned§!! If the contest goes on you may start §Rlosing Spoils§! for good.

§HReturned Spoils§! £victory_points  $AMOUNT_REFUNDED$
§HSpent Spoils§! £victory_points  $AMOUNT_SPENT$
§RLost Spoils§! £victory_points  $AMOUNT_LOST|R$

The longer a contest lasts, the fewer Spoils are returned each time.

When your Demands are contested, most of the Spoils you spent on them are returned to you. But the longer a Demand is contested, the smaller the share returned. This holds for everyone in the contest.
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_CONTESTED_ALL_RESOLVED: Every contested Demand has been settled.
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_HAS_UNRESOLVED_ACTIONS: §RSettle every contested Demand before you send a new one§!

peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_TAKER: $COUNTRY|Y$ will be the beneficiary of the chosen terms
peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_FILTER_LOSER_DESCRIPTION: Choose a single realm to show only the demands you can make against it.

peace_l_english.yml.PEACE_THIRDPARTY_ACTIONS_DESCRIPTION: A §HPeace Council§! is in session. The game goes on when every participant has finished.
